meta.name: session-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when searching Claude Code session transcripts with semantic understanding. Triggers on queries like "find sessions about X", "when did I work on Y", "search previous conversations". Supports natural language queries with synonym matching.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言搜索历史会话记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从大量对话中快速找到之前讨论过的内容
copy.tagline_en: Search past session transcripts with natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find past discussions from many conversations

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的自然语言描述，搜索之前对话记录中相关的会话，并给出摘要和恢复命令。
howto.when: 当你询问“找一下关于 X 的会话”、“我什么时候做过 Y”、“搜索之前的对话”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下上周调试数据库的会话
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出相关会话

say.text: 搜索关于 Obsidian 插件开发的对话
say.note: Claude 会返回匹配的会话摘要

say.text: 查一下我什么时候修复过登录 bug
say.note: Claude 会按时间排序展示相关会话

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search previous session transcripts using natural language queries, returning summaries and resume commands for relevant sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "find sessions about X", "when did I work on Y", "search previous conversations", or similar queries.

say_en.text: Find sessions about debugging the database last week
say_en.note: Claude will search and list relevant sessions

say_en.text: Search conversations about Obsidian plugin development
say_en.note: Claude will return matching session summaries

say_en.text: When did I fix the login bug?
say_en.note: Claude will show relevant sessions sorted by time
